edges.reason: The lever marks the entrance hallway; brown carpet is visible further down the same corridor at Z=3-5
The brown carpet leads to a closed birch trapdoor at Z=6 that physically blocks the 1x2 passage
After mining the closed birch trapdoor, the player enters the room with white stained glass pane walls at Z=7-9
The white glass pane room ends at a solid yellow stained glass wall at Z=10 blocking further progress
Breaking the yellow glass at X=2 Y=1-2 Z=10 reveals a passage with cobblestone slab flooring at Z=11-13
The cobblestone slab passage ends at a solid black terracotta wall at Z=14 that must be mined through
Behind the black terracotta wall is the nether brick room spanning Z=15-18
The spruce button is mounted on the wall inside the nether brick room at X=3 Y=2 Z=17
The spruce button is in the final room before the chicken pen; after this area the player proceeds to the pen at Z=19-20
